# netbox_vlan_translation_rules (Data Source)

Lists vlan_translation_rule objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_vlan_translation_rules" "test" {
  limit = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, local_vid, local_vid__empty, local_vid__gt, local_vid__gte, local_vid__lt, local_vid__lte, local_vid__n, policy_id, policy_id__n, remote_vid, remote_vid__empty, remote_vid__gt, remote_vid__gte, remote_vid__lt, remote_vid__lte, remote_vid__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.

### Read-Only

- `vlan_translation_rules` (Attributes List) The matching vlan_translation_rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vlan_translation_rules))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--vlan_translation_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vlan_translation_rules`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `local_vid` (Number) VLAN id on the local side (1-4094).
- `remote_vid` (Number) VLAN id on the remote side (1-4094).
- `url` (String)
- `vlan_translation_policy_id` (Number) Id of the translation policy the rule belongs to.
